text:
oliver: quick one — noticed p99 for /v1/generate spikes when I filter by customer=partner_x but p50/p95 stable. feels like a dashboard artifact, any checklist?

mina: usually check sample_count, rollup provenance (tdigest/histogram/raw), and whether the slice mixes tags like routing_policy or model_variant.

reza: which panel? new latency panel or legacy?

oliver: new panel. global p50 130ms p95 310ms p99 820ms; partner_x slice p50 132ms p95 318ms p99 2.2s. sample_count ~3.6k for that minute.

metrics-bot: rollup modes: tdigest if n>=10000; histogram if 1000<=n<10000; raw if n<1000. (telemetry/rollups.md)

mina: 3.6k => histogram. our histograms for this endpoint use 100ms buckets. a small number of multi-second fallbacks can fill the top bucket and inflate p99.

oliver: reza — can you run a quick grouped query by routing_policy and model_variant?

reza: ran: 
```
SELECT minute, routing_policy, model_variant, count(*) n, pctl(0.99, latency_ms) p99
FROM requests
WHERE customer='partner_x' AND endpoint='/v1/generate'
GROUP BY minute, routing_policy, model_variant
ORDER BY minute DESC
LIMIT 20;
```

reza: results: p99 spikes align with routing_policy='fallback_to_lowcost' + model_variant='qs8'. That combo is ~0.7% of the slice but latencies 1.4s-3.0s.

mina: yep — tiny origin dominating tail in histogram mode. UX fixes we should do immediately: show provenance badge (tdigest/histogram/raw), sample_count, and top contributor tag next to p99.

ui-team: low-effort mock: show "p99 (histogram · n=3600) — top: routing_policy=fallback_to_lowcost (0.7%)" and offer a quick action "split by routing_policy".

oliver: +1. Also propose a simple "percentile confidence" indicator: high/medium/low. Heuristic: high if provenance=tdigest, medium if histogram && top_contributor<=0.5%, low otherwise. Thoughts?

mina: good starting point. We'll need to tune thresholds but it will reduce pager noise. Also document behavior so SREs don't chase false positives.

reza: medium-term suggestion: implement an "interpolated p99" option: compute p99 per-origin (using raw or tdigest if available) and then aggregate weighted by counts. This avoids coarse-bucket artifacts dominating. Could be behind a feature flag.

ui-team: plus: if confidence=low, panel should auto-suggest helpful next steps: "split by routing_policy", "exclude fallbacks", or "show raw histogram". That helps triage.

metrics-bot: implementation notes: expose API param `by=tag1,tag2` to fetch pctl per-group quickly. Also emit provenance string in rollup metadata so UI can display it without extra queries.

oliver: can someone file a console ticket with repro (queries + screenshots)? I'll attach the grouped results and raw histogram bucket dump. tagging @mina @reza @ui-team.

mina: I'll file CONSOLE-7110: "percentile confidence + provenance badge + quick-split actions". Adding suggested mock and SQL.

reza: one more operational note: for SLOs we should default to excluding non-critical fallbacks or provide explicit SLO-scoped metrics so alerts don't use mixed-origin p99 by default. I'll open an RFC after this.

ui-team: thanks. we'll prototype the badge + quick-actions and share a mock. Closing thread — thx all :white_check_mark:
